title: Each Test Image Deserves A Specific Prompt: Continual Test-Time Adaptation for 2D Medical Image Segmentation (VPTTA)
mechanism: The model stays frozen; each image gets a low-frequency Fourier prompt trained in one iteration by BN-statistics alignment, initialised from a memory bank.
adaptation: Prompt the amplitude spectrum of each 1-channel 512 px EL cell. The loss is BN alignment, the same signal that failed in T9, so the expected gain is low. Include it as a baseline in the TTA track.
min_experiment: Arm: VPTTA ported to 1 channel on FINAL. Baseline: no TTA. Benchmark row; report E1 relF1@2 and the test delta.
evidence: R: beats prior CTTA on optic disc/cup and polyp multi-domain segmentation; 68 citations; widely used as a medical TTA baseline.
prior_overlap: Partial. The supervision signal (BN statistics alignment) overlaps T9, which failed on the same E1-like panels; the input-prompt parameterisation was not run.
